facts.charging: The knight, sword raised high, drives a white horse at full speed and charges toward the left.
facts.red-cape: The red cloak and the red ornament on the helmet stream in the wind.
facts.harness: The horse's chest strap has a butterfly and bird pattern.
facts.bent-trees: The trees behind are bent by the wind.
facts.torn-clouds: Clouds that look torn drift quickly across the sky.

glosses.bent-trees: Speed and wind that sweep over everything around.

reversedGloss.excess: Speed and aggression go too far and invite a collision.
reversedGloss.blocked: Just when it is time to run, the strength drains and he stops.

misdescriptions.wrong: He has put his sword back in its sheath.
